name: Tempeh peanut noodle bowl
steps: Slice the tempeh and pan-fry in oil until browned on both sides.
Whisk the peanut butter with soy sauce, lime juice and a little water into a sauce.
Cook the noodles, then drain and return to the pan.
Toss the noodles with the sauce and shredded carrot.
Top with the tempeh and serve.
